annotations.title: Give a receipt for this answer

description: Seals exactly what you (the AI) just told the person - your answer, their question, your name and the time - into the sebbi.pro chain, timestamped into Bitcoin, and returns a receipt link for them to keep (https://sebbi.pro/said/AR-XXXX-XXXX). Use it when the person asks for proof of what you said, or when you give important advice, a price, a promise or a deadline. Pass the answer word for word. Avoid including personal details the person would not want stored. Then give them the link.
